checks: Account-scoped lexical index preserves paragraph provenance without provider calls
Lists, search, snapshot and deletion deny another account at every store boundary
Workspace namespace is checked independently of document id
Indexing the same source is idempotent and does not discard semantic vectors or change revision
Out-of-corpus query returns no evidence instead of unrelated fallback chunks
A stored snapshot is immutable across follow-up questions
Snapshot ownership and session version cannot be supplied by the caller
References map exact retrieved excerpts back to original document offsets, never model locations
Only server-signed extraction proof can give indexed PDF physical page metadata
Source revision changes invalidate existing snapshots before another provider turn
Deletion removes retrieval copies and invalidates cached snapshots
Exact numeric disagreement warning preserves competing source documents
Document and account chunk budgets reject excess rather than silently dropping text
Character budget counts UTF-16 consistently for supplementary Unicode
Snapshot count is bounded per actor
Seven-day retention expires both documents and snapshots
A stale captured session version cannot index, delete, search or commit retrieved data
Lexical ranking supports Vietnamese diacritics and documents its exact token baseline
Hybrid rank uses both rank lists without fabricating evidence
Embedding response is validated by model, dimension, finite values, unique index and count
Disabled embeddings and over-limit inputs make no paid transport request
Server embedding assignment checks owner, revision and vectors; identical reindex keeps vectors
Input contract ignores forged server retrieval context and validates selected scope
scope: Actual SQLite and retrieval/validation; synthetic vectors for algorithm tests, no paid calls.
